scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/generate_contracts.py && pnpm -C frontend generate:contracts
scripts.format: uv run ruff format backend scripts && pnpm -C frontend format
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check backend scripts && pnpm -C frontend format:check
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check backend scripts && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy backend scripts && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
scripts.test: uv run pytest && pnpm -C frontend test
